short: tokens just after a word for money
notes: Card peaks are on ' be', ' to', ' was' next to money words, and the output promotes ' money', ' capital', ' funds'. Probes: 'money to be' 0.82, 'money was' 0.79, 'cash was' 0.80, 'dollars were' 0.67, 'savings will be' 0.44; same frames with fish, luggage, grain, children at 0.02 or less. 'budget was' 0.09, Bitcoin 0.11, 'earned a lot of money last' 0.12, 'I have some money in' 0.51, so money need not be the subject, though 'money last' was weak. Near misses do not test money as an object.
